nodes.label: Use Prepared Statements Correctly with Pooling
nodes.rationale: Impact HIGH. Named prepared statements are bound to one physical connection, so under transaction-mode pooling the next request lands on a different connection and fails with 'prepared statement does not exist'. Remedies: unnamed prepared statements (most ORM default), DEALLOCATE after use, or session-mode pooling (port 5432 vs 6543); drivers may need prepare:false (node-postgres) or prepareThreshold=0 (JDBC).
